result.title: Learning Across Heterogeneous Feature Spaces with Group Robustness
result.summary: In clinical applications, patients undergo different combinations of tests, and machine learning models must therefore ensure accurate predictions across heterogeneous feature spaces. Current approaches upweight the patients with the highest loss, without accounting for the limited predictive information in their features preventing their loss from going any lower. Moreover, when patients' feature spaces are fully disjoint, current methods reduce to training independent models, preventing knowledge transfer across them. We propose a framework for group robust learning across heterogeneous feature spaces, where groups are patients sharing a feature space. Since a high loss may simply reflect uninformative features, we instead optimize for worst-group excess loss, the gap between a group's loss and an estimate of its achievable optimum. To allow collaboration between groups, we use group-specific encoders mapping into a shared latent space in which learnable Gaussian anchors cluster patients by outcome. On tabular and imaging medical datasets, including fully disjoint feature settings, our framework outperforms state-of-the-art methods when groups differ in their optimal losses or cannot train a good model on their own, reducing worst-group loss by up to 79% and excess loss by up to 95% with up to 18$\times$ fewer parameters.

AI.brief_summary: 针对临床场景中患者检查组合不同、特征空间部分或完全不相交的问题，提出按特征空间分组、优化「最差组超额损失」的组鲁棒学习框架：用组特定编码器把各组输入映射到共享 latent 空间，并以可学习高斯锚点按结局聚类患者，从而在完全不相交的设定下也能跨组迁移知识。
AI.relevance_reason: 共享 latent 空间加结局锚点聚类，以及用「可达最优」衡量损失差距的思路，可能为 LVR 中判断 latent 是否保留任务必要信息、区分无用表示与欠拟合提供可核查的借鉴；但属临床表格与影像数据，与 VLM 推理无直接关系。
